we have demonstrated the first example of an electric field dependent thermal activation energy in a polymeric system.
we have found the electrical conductivity of the poly(4TBA)/poly(methyl methacrylate) blends to increase with the electric field.

the study of electrical and photophysical behavior of a novel poly(6-tbutyl-3, 4dihydro-2 H-1,3benzoxazine)/poly (methylmethacrylale) blend.
